Name: Zechariah, Overseer
Summary: Zechariah, a Levite of the sons of the Kohathites, was an overseer of the workmen repairing the house of the LORD under Josiah.
KeyStory: The overseers included Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set the work forward.
LifeLesson: Kohathite overseers set the temple repair forward.
